articles.summary: create a short excerpt Before an AI agent acts on a webhook, two things have to be true: the event is really from the provider, and it belongs to the right customer. This post walks the full chain of checks and compares how Corsair and Zapier handle each.
articles.title: Corsair vs Zapier: How to Verify and Route Webhooks Before an AI Agent Acts

articles.summary: An AI agent updating a CRM record is only half the job. The other half is your dashboard showing that change fast, and telling the truth when it fails. This post follows one update from agent to screen and compares how a trigger based pipeline and a database backed layer handle it.
articles.title: Corsair vs Zapier: Keeping AI Agent Actions and Customer Dashboards in Sync

articles.summary: An agent reads a deal, a rep edits it moments later, and the agent saves the old values over the top. Nothing errors, and the rep's change is gone. Here's how to catch that conflict before the write, and where the guard lives in Corsair versus n8n.
articles.title: Corsair vs n8n: Preventing Conflicting Updates When Agents and Users Edit the Same Record
